## Added

- Added background blur for panels, with an on/off switch in panel settings. Corner rounding is limited to 0, 4 or 8 px while blur is on.
- Added a "Lock all panels" option to the tray menu.
- Added a notification window in the application's own style, with a "Rozumiem" button. It is shown only on the primary monitor.
- Added a first-run setup: on a fresh install the app pins its tray icon automatically and shows the notification explaining how to open the management menu.
- Added icons to the tray menu.

## Changes

- Changed Setup to install per-user by default, so updates run without a UAC prompt. Use `/ALLUSERS` for a machine-wide install.
- Changed the tray menu: removed the wallpaper entry, renamed "Zarządzanie" to "Panel ustawień", and aligned the item text.
- Changed the Panels tab layouts button to "Zarządzaj układami".

## Fixed

- Fixed the panel header double-click not opening settings when the panel background is fully transparent.

## Download

Windows x64 Setup EXE.
